description: This file contains functions and type definitions for resolving and managing Microsoft Teams (MSTeams) routing, group policies, and reply configurations within a larger application. It includes route resolution, group tool policy resolution, allowlist matching, reply policy determination, and group permission checks.

methods.name: resolveMSTeamsRouteConfig
methods.description: Resolves the route configuration for a given MSTeams context based on provided parameters such as team ID, team name, conversation ID, and channel name, determining access and configuration details.

methods.name: resolveMSTeamsGroupToolPolicy
methods.description: Determines the group tool policy for a specified MSTeams group context, resolving route configuration and associated tools or policies.

methods.name: resolveMSTeamsAllowlistMatch
methods.description: Resolves an allowlist match for MSTeams sender based on provided allowFrom list, sender ID, and optional name matching.

methods.name: resolveMSTeamsReplyPolicy
methods.description: Determines the reply policy for MSTeams based on whether the message is a direct message and configuration settings, including whether to require mentions and reply style.

methods.name: isMSTeamsGroupAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a MSTeams group is allowed based on group policy, sender information, and allowlist.
